title: Training record details
purpose: Read one immutable training or demonstration record, its evidence and related records.

sections.title: Training access
paragraphs: Admin, reviewer, approver and project manager roles can read all staff training and evidence. Custodian and analyst roles see only their own, including when guessing a record/download link. Only admin and reviewer roles can create, renew or correct training. Staff and reviewer selectors contain active non-client accounts ordered by username, showing full name and username where available.

items.label: Subject, State, Staff and Type
items.description: Header identifies the topic, computed state, separate renewed marker, trainee and record type.

items.label: Correct record
items.description: Admin/reviewer roles see it only on a record without a correction. Creates a linked replacement with a required reason; original stays as history.

items.label: Renew record
items.description: Admin/reviewer roles see it only on an uncorrected record, even if it already has renewals. Appends another record for the same person, type and method version. Does not modify the original. A record that was corrected cannot be renewed; renew its correction.

items.label: a correction
items.description: A superseded record shows a notice linking to its replacement; follow this to the current corrected entry.

items.label: Subject
items.description: Recorded training topic, SOP or demonstration title.

items.label: Method and version
items.description: Specific configured method and title, or dash.

items.label: Matrix
items.description: Recorded Water, Wastewater or Soil scope, or Not specific.

items.label: Scope
items.description: Entered analytes, techniques or limits demonstrated.

items.label: Expires
items.description: Lab-set expiry or No expiry set.

items.label: Reviewed by
items.description: Independent reviewer and review date; reviewer differs from trainee.

items.label: Reference
items.description: Training sheet, DOC dataset or SOP identifier, or dash.

items.label: Evidence
items.description: Stored file link, size and shortened checksum or No file.

items.label: Correction reason
items.description: Displayed on a replacement record when supplied.

items.label: Recorded by
items.description: Recording actor and system timestamp, distinct from trainee and reviewer.

sections.title: Computed training state
paragraphs: State is evaluated on the deployment local date. Corrected takes precedence when a replacement exists, then Not acceptable, then Not yet effective when the effective date is future, then Expired after expiry, otherwise Current. Records are valid through the expiry date, and blank expiry never expires by date. Renewed is a separate marker: an acceptable, effective, uncorrected renewal exists; its own expiry is not checked for that marker. Renewal does not rewrite the earlier record state. These records grant no application role, result-entry authorization or report-release permission.

sections.title: Records for this person and method
paragraphs: Shows up to 30 records for the same staff member and exact method, newest effective date first then ID descending. For a record without a method, this includes that person’s other methodless records. It is not limited by matrix, type or renewal chain. Subject links to each record; Effective, Expires and State describe that row, and renewal marks records with a renewal link. The current row is identified. Count is rows shown; earlier records remain in the Training list.

sections.title: Evidence files
paragraphs: Attach a nonempty PDF, PNG, JPEG, TXT or CSV no larger than 10 MiB. TXT/CSV must be UTF-8; PDF and image bytes must match the extension. Evidence is optional unless a step requires a reference or file. Downloads are attachments, not inline previews. File links show name, size and the first 12 SHA-256 checksum characters. No file indicates no stored attachment. Staff can download equipment/nonconformance evidence; training evidence is limited to the person and lead roles. A correction is a new record: an earlier attachment is not copied automatically, so attach evidence again if it belongs on the new record.

sections.title: History
paragraphs: History shows up to the latest 30 audit events, oldest of those first and the newest last. Each shows action, recorded time, actor and reason when supplied. If the record has more than 30 audit events, older events beyond this cap are not shown in this panel. They remain stored. This panel is separate from the operational ledger or timeline.

sections.title: Record footer
paragraphs: The footer repeats the record identifier and shows Viewed with the time this page was produced in the deployment time zone and the signed-in viewer. This is a viewing timestamp, distinct from creation, event, review or closure time. Numbered section headings identify panels on the record page.
